excludedPolicy: Every source object absent from the explicit approved lists has no new ambient matrix delta, including people, architecture, flower-rock-cloud combinations, palace/crowd plates and figure/clothing/ribbon composites. Source-authored camera, matrix, visibility and material reveal animation is preserved independently.

supplement.role: Only the middle, isolated painted petal is UV-cropped onto a small curved mesh; no atlas group is moved as a whole.
supplement.retainedFile: The actual 2.0 exported texture; no old-asset fallback or regenerated bitmap.

limits: This is visual-eligibility and exact-binding evidence; final rendered look, node visibility and FPS require parent browser acceptance.
Additional particle allocations are two per authored reading stop, with at most two visible petals plus one eligible native layer at a time.
Some source-authored matrices already move; these are preserved as authored even for objects excluded from additional environment motion.
Blender material sourceEffects are driven by the separate source shader progress and are not replaced by these ambient bindings.
